meta.methodology: production agent session store, 30-day window (n snapshot at audit time). events[] are (class_id, session_id) pairs in global arrival order; class_id maps to a tool name + sha256 of the sentinel-engine signature (URLs/paths/numbers/hexes normalized away) — the mapping itself is NOT included, so no raw error text, content, timestamp or real session id can be recovered; session ids are opaque first-appearance ids. gaps: consecutive same-class events within one session, capped at 4h.
